validated_objective: Release QIF v0.8.9 with deterministic policy-state drift assessment and a bounded, human-governed emergency demotion evidence chain.
scope: Portable policy-state observation history linked to the approved baseline and evidence.
Deterministic drift classification, severity, governance routing, and current-state reconciliation.
Emergency demotion authority, target policy, scope, reason, deadline, execution reconciliation, and status.
Schemas, examples, verifier rules, retained fixtures, docs, portable package, changelog, roadmap, AOF log, tests, tag, and GitHub release.
constraints: Do not build UI, external integrations, continuous monitoring services, autonomous authority, live deployment, employee surveillance, or semantic-truth claims.
Do not mutate historical promotion or observation records.
expected_outcomes: Material and unverified drift fail closed and trigger governance.
Emergency demotion is explainable, authority-bounded, evidence-linked, and reconciled after execution.
QIF v0.8.9 passes all local tests and AOF runtime verification and ships with a portable artifact.
